sweep_order: Run a full football-development sweep across all 162 active players first.
Capture material developments even when ECR or ADP has not moved.
Evaluate RB backfield battles for lead-role share, early-down work, passing-down work, goal-line work, snap share, touch share, and contingency value.
Evaluate WR and TE target battles for route participation, first-team usage, target share, slot/outside role, red-zone usage, quarterback rapport, and depth-chart movement.
Evaluate injuries, suspensions, discipline, roster moves and return timetables before interpreting market movement.
Only after the football sweep is complete, compare current ECR/ADP to the locked market baseline and determine Market Value impact.
Market movement alone may change acquisition strategy or BUY/FAIR/REACH/FADE, but may not rewrite True Value without independent football evidence.
Any development that materially changes role, workload, target/touch expectation, availability, offensive environment, or reliability reopens True Value review under the normal model gate.
Small market moves are excluded unless they cross a meaningful draft-price threshold or are supported by football developments.
The canonical report table uses columns: Player, ECR old → new, ADP old → new, Model impact. Model impact must state effects on True Value, Overall/Actionable Draft Board, and Market Value.

camp_phase_rule.stop_condition: The dedicated training-camp-news sync stops when NFL training camp/preseason camp phase has ended for the 2026 season.
camp_phase_rule.post_camp_behavior: After camp ends, continue the full development sweep using regular-season practice reports, injury reports, suspensions/discipline, depth-chart and role changes, roster transactions, weekly usage, and market movement. Do not continue labeling ordinary in-season updates as training-camp news.

anti_rules: Do not filter the football-development sweep only to players with meaningful ECR/ADP movement.
Do not treat no market movement as no news.
Do not infer a role win from one camp report, one preseason play, or unsupported narrative.
Do not let ADP/ECR contaminate the independent football projection or True Value.
Do not double-count correlated role signals from the same underlying event.
